## Consultation Plans & Pricing
- **Reserve Your Slot (Introductory)**: ₹101 — 10-minute 1:1 audio consultation call with the astrologer plus a detailed personal horoscope PDF report.

- **Detailed Kundali Analysis**: ₹1,499 — Comprehensive birth chart evaluation covering Mahadasha, Antardasha timing, planetary transits, and customized Vedic remedies (upay).
- **Marriage Matchmaking Analysis (Kundli Milan)**: ₹1,499 — Two Kundlis compared for marriage compatibility, 36 Guna Milan, Manglik Dosh check, and relationship harmony remedies.
